children: Shares of Bloom Energy were higher after the company was selected to join the S&P 500 index.
The stock was up 11% to $279.92 as of midday Tuesday. Shares have more than tripled in value this year.

S&P Dow Jones Indices announced late last week that the fuel-cell technology provider would join the S&P 500 index, along with Everpure and Illumina. The Trade Desk, Builders FirstSource, and Molson Coors Beverage are being removed from the index.
The changes are effective at the beginning of trading on Sept. 21.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
